Container.Name: unraid-zip-watcher
Container.Overview: Very small background service that watches a folder for stable ZIP files and extracts each new or changed archive into a same-named subfolder. ZIP Slip paths and symbolic links are rejected. Processing state is stored in the state path so restarts do not repeat completed archives.

Config.Name: Watch directory
Config.Description: Host folder to scan (non-recursively) for .zip files.

Config.Name: Output directory
Config.Description: Host folder where each archive is extracted into a same-named subfolder.

Config.Name: State directory
Config.Description: Persistent state directory. Keep this mapped to avoid reprocessing archives after container recreation.

Config.Name: Poll interval
Config.Description: How often to scan the watch directory. Go duration such as 5s or 1m.

Config.Name: Stable scans
Config.Description: Number of unchanged scans required before extraction. Helps avoid reading a ZIP while it is still being copied.

Config.Name: Delete ZIP after success
Config.Description: Delete the source ZIP only after successful extraction. Keep false if you want to retain source archives.

Config.Name: Maximum uncompressed bytes
Config.Description: Optional decompression limit in bytes. Default is 10 GiB; set 0 for unlimited.

Config.Name: Maximum entry bytes
Config.Description: Reject an individual ZIP entry larger than this many uncompressed bytes. 0 means unlimited.

Config.Name: Maximum entries
Config.Description: Reject ZIP archives containing more than this many entries.
